diagnosis: BatchUploadReceiptsMutation accepts an integer report_id and a list of Upload scalar files, persisting new receipt records against the designated ExpenseReport without verifying that the requesting employee owns the report. An attacker can inject unauthorized receipts into other employees' pending expense claims to corrupt audit trails or submit fraudulent reimbursement claims.
